\begin{exercise} \end{exercise}

↗ prob:1-9 2-8. Define $F : {\mathbb {R}}^{n} \rightarrow {\mathbb {{RP}}}^{n}$ by $F\left( {{x}^{1},\ldots ,{x}^{n}}\right) = \left\lbrack {{x}^{1},\ldots ,{x}^{n},1}\right\rbrack $ . Show that $F$ is a diffeomorphism onto a dense open subset of ${\mathbb {{RP}}}^{n}$ . Do the same for $G : {\mathbb {C}}^{n} \rightarrow {\mathbb {{CP}}}^{n}$ defined by $G\left( {{z}^{1},\ldots ,{z}^{n}}\right) = \left\lbrack {{z}^{1},\ldots ,{z}^{n},1}\right\rbrack $ (see Problem 1-9). \end{exercise}
